items.title: The Lakers finish strong down the stretch, beating the Hawks 124-114 on the road. Luka Dončić scored 32 points. Walker Kessler had another double-double with 21 points and 10 rebounds. Off the bench, Sandro Mamukelashvili had 23 points, and Collin Sexton scored 18 in the win.

items.body_excerpt: He's such a monster offensively. So happy with how he's played for us. Easily his best game in purple and gold. Hoping for even more from you Mamu. Lakers advance to 10-2!!! Holding the best record in the league. Maybe this Lakers team is good. Idk. Box Score
